title: Person
description: A real human being who may be a guest candidate, a host, a publicist, an organizational contact, or any other participant. A Person is not a Guest — guest status is carried by AppearanceOpportunity. One Person may have many AppearanceOpportunities across shows and years.

person_id.description: Stable UUID or slug for this person across all shows and tenants.

canonical_name.description: The public name used to identify this person (first + last, stage name, mononym).

pronunciation.description: IPA or phonetic spelling of the canonical name. Used in host prep packets.

pronouns.description: Stated pronouns (e.g. she/her, they/them). Volunteer information only.

bio.description: Short factual biography drawn from public sources. No invented claims.

public_roles.description: Current public-facing roles (e.g. author, musician, therapist, CEO).

organizations.description: Organizations this person is publicly affiliated with.

public_links.description: Publicly discoverable profile URLs with verification timestamps.

care_profile_id.description: Reference to a GuestCareProfile record for this person (see spec/care_profile.schema.json). Null until intake consent is obtained and the care profile is populated.

risk_level.description: Operational risk classification. Elevated triggers additional human checkpoints.

relationship_strength.description: Relationship class relative to the primary relationship owner. See relationship.schema.json and permission-matrix.yaml.

relationship_owner.description: person_id of the host or team member who owns the relationship with this person.

do_not_contact.description: If true, no outreach of any kind may be sent. Hard stop — no automation overrides this.

source_provenance.description: How this person entered the system (e.g. RSS archive ingest, manual entry, referral).
